title: Congress votes on trillions of dollars in spending… and you can literally see which stocks members are buying and selling.
author: surfer_sloth
selftext:
https://valarn.com/en

That’s pretty wild.

You can also track trades made by company insiders — the executives actually running the businesses.

None of this means their trades predict the market. Disclosures can be delayed, context matters, and plenty of trades mean nothing on their own.  
But it’s still a fascinating signal to add to the research process.

Valarn pulls insider + congressional trades into one place so you can quickly see who’s buying, who’s selling, and whether that activity supports or contradicts the broader thesis.

Because sometimes the most interesting question isn’t:

“What does AI think?”  
It’s:  
“What are the people closest to the money actually doing?”
